subject: Future Tech
title: Photonic Quantum Chips
description: A fast breakdown of Photonic Quantum Chips for builders.

hook.text: Some teams skip the freezer entirely. Photonic quantum computers use particles of light as qubits.

buildup.text: Photons naturally resist decoherence. They barely interact with their environment, which is a huge strength.

discovery.text: Xanadu and PsiQuantum are building photonic chips that work at room temperature on silicon wafers.

twist.text: The catch: photons are hard to make interact. Two-qubit gates require clever tricks with beam splitters.

climax.text: If photonic methods scale, quantum computers could shrink from lab-sized machines to standard server racks.

punchline.text: Light may carry quantum computing out of the freezer.

quiz.question: What is the main advantage of photonic qubits?
options: They resist decoherence at room temperature
